tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: Search for financial instruments by free-text query. Returns matching instruments with their FIGIs, exchange, country, currency, security type, and Bloomberg-style identifiers. Use this when the user mentions a company name or partial ticker and you don't have an exact ticker yet. For example: "find Apple" or "what's the ticker for Vodafone".

q.description: Free-text search query (company name or partial ticker)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 25, max 100)

exchange.description: Optional MIC code filter (e.g., XNAS, XLON, XETR)

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific instrument by ticker, including all its identifiers (FIGI, ISIN, CIK, etc.) and listings across exchanges. Use after `search_instruments` when you know the canonical ticker, or when the user provides one directly. Use the `identifiers` parameter to control how much identifier detail you get back: 'primary' returns only the canonical few (composite_figi, share_class_figi, ticker, isin, cik), 'none' returns no identifiers (just metadata + listings), 'all' (default) returns everything.

identifiers.description: Which identifiers to include in the response

exchange.description: Optional MIC code to filter listings (e.g., XNAS to see only the NASDAQ listing)

tools.name: get_prices_eod
tools.description: Get daily end-of-day price history for a ticker (open/high/low/close/volume per trading day). Defaults to the last year of data. Use this for chart data, price analysis, return calculations, or any historical price lookups. The `exchange` parameter is optional — if omitted, the instrument's primary listing is used.

exchange.description: Optional MIC code (e.g., XNAS); defaults to the instrument's primary listing

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to one year before today

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Get SEC EDGAR XBRL fundamentals (financial statement line items) for a US-listed company by ticker. Returns rows with concept names (e.g., 'us-gaap:Revenues', 'us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss'), fiscal year/period, value, unit, and filing date. Use this for financial analysis, ratio calculations, growth analysis, or any fundamental research. Optional `concept` parameter filters to a single XBRL concept (e.g., 'us-gaap:Revenues') — useful when you only need one line item rather than the full statement.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol (US-listed companies only — fundamentals come from SEC EDGAR)

concept.description: Optional XBRL concept name (e.g., 'us-gaap:Revenues'); when omitted, returns all concepts
